About Us

27 Years' Experience, Now Under Our Own Name

We're B Lala Construction, based on St James Street in Walthamstow. The company is new, but the experience behind it isn't: 27 years of renovating, extending and repairing homes. We take on the building work and the finishing trades ourselves, so one team looks after your job from the first visit to the final coat of paint.

Every job starts with a free quote. We come out, look at what you want doing and give you a clear quote before any work starts, whether it's a full house renovation or a small repair.

Why Choose B Lala Construction

  • 27 years' experienceNearly three decades of building work behind every job we take on.
  • Free quotesWe visit, look at the job and quote for free, with no obligation.
  • One team, start to finishBuilding work, plastering, tiling, flooring and decorating, all handled by us.
  • Local to WalthamstowBased on St James Street and working across North and East London.
